harbor_square.name: Central Harbor Square
harbor_square.description: A sunlit square paved with cobblestone overlooking the royal harbor. In the center stands the statue of Arvendale's founder. Captain Eliza watches over the docks.

market_street.name: Market Street
market_street.description: A lively avenue lined with colorful merchant awnings and bustling stalls. To the west rings the hammer of the Blacksmith's Forge, while the Town Guide and Quest Advisor stand near the fountain.

blacksmith_forge.name: Royal Blacksmith Forge
blacksmith_forge.description: Heat radiates from a roaring stone furnace. A newly forged Iron Sword and a reinforced Oak Shield rest beside Master Borin's anvil.

apothecary.name: Apothecary Shop
apothecary.description: Sunlight streams through stained glass onto shelves of crimson healing elixirs, dried roots, and alchemical flasks.

tavern.name: The Salty Siren Tavern
tavern.description: A cozy harbor inn filled with warm hearthlight, the aroma of fresh crusty bread, and bottles of aged port wine.

docks.name: The Great Pier
docks.description: Weathered timber planks creak above deep harbor waters. The corrupt and heavily armored Dock Warden blocks the pier near the eastern warehouse.

warehouse.name: Abandoned Warehouse
warehouse.description: A shadowy storehouse at the edge of the pier filled with stolen royal cargo. A dangerous Shadow Smuggler guards a desk with sealed documents.

town_gate.name: North Town Gate
town_gate.description: Massive iron-bound stone gates adorned with blue and gold banners, marking the boundary between the city and the northern forest. An Explorer's Seal rests on the guard post.

forest_edge.name: Whispering Forest Edge
forest_edge.description: Golden sunbeams filter through ancient pines onto mossy stones where rare medicinal herbs grow. A ferocious Dire Wolf prowls among the shadows.

item.iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
item.iron_sword.description: A sturdy iron blade forged by Master Borin. Passively increases Attack by +6 in combat.

item.oak_shield.name: Oak Shield
item.oak_shield.description: A heavy oak shield reinforced with iron bands. Passively increases Defense by +4 in combat.

item.leather_boots.name: Pathfinder Boots
item.leather_boots.description: Reinforced leather boots awarded for scouting Arvendale. Increases Defense by +2 and Speed by +5.

item.iron_gauntlets.name: Alchemist's Iron Gauntlets
item.iron_gauntlets.description: Runed gauntlets gifted by Apprentice Elisa. Increases Attack by +3 and Defense by +3.

item.steel_breastplate.name: Royal Guard Breastplate
item.steel_breastplate.description: Polished steel armor awarded by Captain Eliza. Increases Defense by +6 against heavy strikes.

item.royal_helmet.name: Helm of Arvendale
item.royal_helmet.description: The champion's crested helm awarded for solving the harbor conspiracy. Increases Attack by +2 and Defense by +5.

item.healing_potion.name: Healing Elixir
item.healing_potion.description: A bright crimson alchemical elixir that restores 40 HP when used.

item.bread.name: Fresh Bread
item.bread.description: A warm, crusty loaf baked at The Salty Siren Tavern. Restores 15 HP when eaten.

item.wine.name: Harbor Vintage Wine
item.wine.description: A bottle of rich spiced wine from The Salty Siren. Restores 25 HP when used.

item.explorer_token.name: Northern Gate Seal
item.explorer_token.description: A stamped brass token from the North Town Gate proving you have scouted the city perimeter.

item.herbs.name: Healing Herbs
item.herbs.description: Fragrant medicinal herbs gathered from the Whispering Forest or dropped by the Dire Wolf.

item.compromise_letter.name: Incriminating Letter
item.compromise_letter.description: A sealed letter proving the smuggling conspiracy. Bring it to Captain Eliza on Harbor Square.

item.missing_ships_report.name: Missing Ships Report
item.missing_ships_report.description: The Dock Warden's secret ledger detailing every ship that vanished from Arvendale. Bring it to Captain Eliza.

item.gold_coins.name: Purse of Gold Coins
item.gold_coins.description: A heavy purse of royal gold coins looted from the harbor conspirators.

item.rope.name: Hempen Rope
item.rope.description: A strong coil of braided sailors' rope found on the harbor square.

item.lantern.name: Brass Lantern
item.lantern.description: A polished brass oil lantern that illuminates dark piers and storehouses.

item.pouch.name: Leather Pouch
item.pouch.description: A sturdy utility belt pouch sold at the market stalls.

default: The harbor holds dark secrets, adventurer. Stay vigilant.

available: Smugglers have taken over the Abandoned Warehouse east of the docks.
Defeat the Shadow Smuggler or search the warehouse for the Incriminating Letter, and I will reward you with a Royal Guard Breastplate!
active: Have you recovered the Incriminating Letter from the Abandoned Warehouse yet?
Without hard evidence, I cannot arrest the conspirators.
completed: This letter confirms my worst fears! Take this Royal Guard Breastplate — you have earned it.
locked: We have other matters to settle first.

available: Now that the smugglers are exposed, we know the Dock Warden on The Great Pier is behind the vanishing ships!
He is heavily armored — make sure you have full armor and weapons before challenging him. Bring me the Missing Ships Report to claim the Helm of Arvendale!
active: Defeat the corrupt Dock Warden or secure the Missing Ships Report to end this conspiracy once and for all.
completed: You defeated the Warden and recovered the ledger! Arvendale is forever in your debt. Wear the Helm of Arvendale with pride, Champion!
locked: First help me expose the smugglers in the warehouse.

default: Looking for quests? I offer the scouting trial for Pathfinder Boots, Apprentice Elisa in the Apothecary needs forest herbs, and Captain Eliza on Harbor Square leads the harbor investigation!

available: Welcome, adventurer! Your first task is to scout our realm. Travel north to the North Town Gate, pick up the Northern Gate Seal, and bring it back to me for a pair of Pathfinder Boots! (Also visit Apprentice Elisa in the Apothecary East and Captain Eliza South for more quests).
active: Travel north to the North Town Gate, take the Northern Gate Seal, and return here to claim your Pathfinder Boots!
completed: Well done scouting the city! Here are your Pathfinder Boots (+2 Defense, +5 Speed). Now speak to Apprentice Elisa in the Apothecary and Captain Eliza on Harbor Square!

default: The herbs from the Whispering Forest can heal any wound. Be careful of the Dire Wolf!

available: Many townsfolk are injured, and my supplies are low! Venture north past the Town Gate into the Whispering Forest.
Slay the Dire Wolf or gather Healing Herbs there, and I will reward you with Alchemist's Iron Gauntlets and a Healing Elixir!
active: Have you brought the Healing Herbs from the Whispering Forest? Watch out for the Dire Wolf!
completed: Marvelous! These herbs will save lives. Take these Alchemist's Iron Gauntlets (+3 Attack, +3 Defense) and a Healing Elixir!

default: Want to know where to find gear? Head West to the Blacksmith Forge for an Iron Sword and Oak Shield! Head East to the Apothecary for Healing Elixirs, or visit the Tavern for Bread and Wine. Documents lie in the Warehouse, and Herbs grow in the Northern Forest!
Steel and oak keep an adventurer breathing! Take the Iron Sword and Oak Shield beside my anvil — you'll need every bit of armor before facing the Dock Warden.
Welcome to The Salty Siren! Help yourself to Fresh Bread (+15 HP) and Harbor Vintage Wine (+25 HP) to recover your strength during battle.
I used to be an adventurer like you, then I took an arrow in the knee... Now I guard the northern gate while Dire Wolves prowl the woods beyond.
The wolf snarls fiercely, guarding the patch of medicinal herbs with bared fangs.
You've seen too much! You won't leave this warehouse alive with our letters!
Foolish whelp! Without legendary armor and a forged blade, my halberd will crush you in seconds!

quest.explore_arvendale.name: Scout the Realm of Arvendale
quest.explore_arvendale.description: Explore the city to the North Town Gate, retrieve the Northern Gate Seal, and return to the Quest Advisor on Market Street.

quest.expose_smugglers.name: Expose the Harbor Smugglers
quest.expose_smugglers.description: Defeat the Shadow Smuggler or recover the Incriminating Letter from the Abandoned Warehouse and bring it to Captain Eliza.

quest.investigate_missing_ships.name: The Vanishing Fleet
quest.investigate_missing_ships.description: Defeat the heavily armored Dock Warden on The Great Pier or secure the Missing Ships Report and deliver it to Captain Eliza.

quest.gather_herbs.name: Remedies of the Whispering Woods
quest.gather_herbs.description: Defeat the Dire Wolf or gather Healing Herbs from the Whispering Forest Edge and bring them to Apprentice Elisa in the Apothecary.
